description: Timed the apparel at two hours and fifty minutes, and circled neither hearing.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Stood the apparel. The page came through Kemp. They added no speech.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Stood the morning in two cloaks, and said there is a hall that would hold a winter.
name: James Burbage

description: Held Juliet low, lay on the trestle, and would not discuss the doublet.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Kept his eyes on Nick, and heard the cue as fire on his own word.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Was told to leave something of the Nurse for Saturday, and kept it.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Brought the report of the thirty-first of November, and did not spend the fan.
name: Will Kemp

description: Repeated the sentence, and did not extend it.
name: William Shakespeare
